title: Spire2 Pile Viewer
description:
See your teammates' draw, exhaust, and discard piles, and their hand, in co-op.

[list]
[*] Each teammate gets a strip with live pile counts. [b]Click[/b] a pile to open it. [b]Drag[/b] a strip to move it.
[*] Your teammate's hand is shown behind yours, with their live costs and playable glow. Hover a card to see it in full.
[*] Click the eye in a strip to switch teammates. [b]Hide hand[/b] (or H) hides your own hand to read theirs.
[*] Hotkeys: Shift+Z / V / C / H for teammate 1's draw / exhaust / discard / hand (Ctrl+ for teammate 2, Ctrl+Shift+ for teammate 3).
[*] [b]F1[/b] for settings.
[/list]

Source: https://github.com/hanryhu/Spire2PileViewer
Architecture adapted from BetterSpire2 by jdr.
